_why: The local bake-off was null for all four methods, but at 396 games/method the winner-of-11 inflation was $4,130 against a $3,000 effect -- the instrument could not resolve it. Per-world sd is $34,749; paired against the base on the same world it is $17,168. Keeping the winner's curse under half the effect needs ~890 worlds per evaluation at 30 evaluations = ~27,000 games, which is an 11h kernel and not a local run. BO is the method sent: it was the only one that declined to chase a lucky evaluation locally, and it is the most sample-efficient at the ~30 evaluations this budget allows.
